description.value: Pizza Pizza is a national Canadian pizza chain founded in 1967, with this location on Lansdowne Street in central Kamloops. It offers counter service pizza by the slice or whole pie, with takeout and delivery available. The menu includes gluten-free crust and plant-based options alongside the standard lineup, making it a flexible quick-stop for cyclists with dietary restrictions.
